description:
Did you know millipedes were the first animals to breathe air on land, over 420 million years ago? These fascinating arthropods are nature's unsung heroes, breaking down decaying plant matter and keeping our soil healthy. In this video, we dive into the incredible world of millipedes, exploring their unique features, defense mechanisms (some even produce cyanide!), and their crucial role in the ecosystem.
